notes: New `nexa test create`, `nexa test check` and `nexa test export-excel`: test cases are written as reviewable Markdown from BD/DD documents, test viewpoints and a test policy, then exported to Excel by code, the same Markdown always giving the same workbook. `nexa-design` now ships as a builtin skill, `nexa scan docs` reads Excel, PowerPoint and PDF, and Pi is the only TUI.
